rationale: Public U11 large-image streaming preparation only. Observed 223132.528 ms encode/preparation time plus 25% allowance rounded to 280 seconds. Fixed 64 MiB process and 64 KiB transient tile-index ceilings leave space for allocator/library variation while remaining independent of image area; baseline 5520 KiB and 16544 bytes. Stored representation cap allows about 2.4 bits per sample including headers at the selected 2 bpp target. Descriptor index must remain at most 1% of representation bytes (baseline 0.68%). Exactly one callback per 512-square tile and exact native sample byte total enforce the selected geometry. This does not freeze unmeasured NITF preparation latency or establish real-source rights, storage coldness or physical NFS traffic.
